About Vital Lyfe

Vital Lyfe is a tech company redefining water autonomy through innovation, creating a new category of personal water making technology built to scale where infrastructure can’t.

The Mission

We're looking for a Software Engineering Intern to help build the software behind a high-demand consumer hardware product. We're spinning up manufacturing from scratch, scaling fast, and the software you work on will directly affect how we build, track, and deliver thousands of units.

You'll work alongside senior engineers on the tools, data systems, and infrastructure that power our operations and help us scale.

What You'll Do



-  Build and improve internal tools that give our engineering and operations teams real-time visibility into production and manufacturing workflows
-  Write integrations and scripts that connect systems and keep data reliable across the company
-  Design and maintain dashboards that help teams understand operational data and make better decisions
-  Assist with backend and cloud infrastructure work as we continue scaling our services
-  Debug issues, write tests, and ship improvements alongside senior engineers

What We're Looking For



-  Strong programming fundamentals and comfort learning new systems quickly
-  Experience with at least one modern programming language such as Python or TypeScript
-  Interest in software that supports real-world products and operations
-  Familiarity with APIs, web applications, or cloud-based systems
-  Practical and curious, with a habit of taking ownership and following through
-  Able to break down a problem, work through it, and know when to ask for help
-  Excited to work in a fast-paced environment where software and hardware intersect

Nice to Have



-  Experience supporting or contributing to live backend systems
-  Background in building user-facing interfaces with React or a similar frontend framework
-  Exposure to SQL, structured data formats, and dashboards or data visualization tools
-  Familiarity with AWS or cloud infrastructure
-  Interest in manufacturing, hardware-software integration, or IoT systems

Physical Job Requirements - Essential Functions



- Hands on work on development hardware.
- Lift and carry up to 50 lbs. unassisted
- Work involves standing, crouching, and walking for extended periods. Suitable seating is provided when the nature of the work reasonably permits.
- Wear required PPE (safety glasses, gloves, safety shoes) in production areas. Required personal protective equipment (PPE), including safety shoes, will be provided or reimbursed by Vital Lyfe.

Why Join Vital Lyfe?



-  Work on high impact problems with global relevance
-  Contribute to technology addressing water security and climate resilience
-  Tackle meaningful problems at the intersection of software, hardware, and operations
-  See your work directly affect how we build, ship, and improve real-world products
-  Learn quickly in a collaborative environment with broad exposure across engineering

Location Requirement: Ability to work 100% onsite in Torrance, CA (remote or hybrid work will not be considered)

Vital Lyfe is an Equal Opportunity Employer; employment with Vital Lyfe is governed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications and will not be influenced in any manner by race, color, religion, gender, national origin/ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, mental or physical disability or any other legally protected status.
fit_why: Internal tools, dashboards, APIs fit; hardware/manufacturing exposure is a gap

jd:
Job Description

What you'll bring

You're enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. You want to apply your programming skills to enterprise AI and gain hands-on experience building production software.



- Technical experience in Python, Java, JavaScript, or another programming language
- Familiarity with REST APIs, Git, and SQL or NoSQL databases
- A solid grasp of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
- A customer-oriented mindset — you consider how your work affects end users
- Some experience with AI tools or concepts, or genuine curiosity to explore them
- Strong analytical thinking and clear communication skills in English

We also look for people who communicate clearly, keep the customer in mind, and enjoy finding smart solutions to problems — whatever stage of your career you're at.

In addition to the role-specific skills above, all student and early talent positions at SAP look for candidates who are open to working with AI tools — including agentic AI — to automate everyday tasks, prototype ideas, and build confidence in AI-assisted ways of working from day one.

What You'll Build

You'll join SAP Customer Industry Solutions (CIS) and contribute to enterprise AI applications serving customers across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. Your work will span AI agents, backend services, and full-stack features.



- Develop AI-powered features and software components for enterprise applications
- Build RESTful APIs and backend services that power intelligent AI workflows

role: Contract Student Worker - Software Engineer (20/hrs week)
jd:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Contract Student Worker Program

Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview

Zoox is bringing its robotaxi service to cities across the US. Every new city needs depots to house and maintain the fleet, and pickup/dropoff locations at the places riders want to go most: hotels, airports, stadiums and event venues. In this role, you will own and grow the internal web tools that coordinate this rollout, giving teams a single, clear view of every site from planning to launch.

Responsibilities



- Own the expansion-tracking web tools end to end, from feature request to release
- Build new views, dashboards, and workflows that help teams launch new cities and bring service to high-profile airports, venues, and hotels
- Develop and extend integrations with Jira so project status stays accurate and up to date
- Partner with operations and engineering teams to understand their needs and turn them into features
- Keep the tools reliable and easy to use as the number of sites grows

Required Qualifications



- Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, HTML, and CSS
- Experience working with REST APIs
- Comfortable with Git and code review
- Self-starter who takes ownership and works well independently
- Clear written and verbal communication

Bonus Qualifications



- Experience building web apps or dashboards end to end
- Familiarity with Jira or similar project-tracking tools
- Experience deploying web services
- Data visualization experience
- Interest in autonomous vehicles, operations, or scaling a product to new markets

Program Requirements



- Comfortable with Git and code review
- Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.
- Self-starter who takes ownership and works well independently
- Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.
- Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.
- Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. The Contract Student Worker Program is designed to complement your academic experience by providing meaningful, ongoing work alongside your studies. Rather than participating in a cohort-based program, you'll join a team directly and contribute to real projects with real impact. While the program does not include structured intern programming or a pathway to full-time employment, it offers valuable opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and gain hands-on experience in a professional environment.

Compensation for this role is $30/hour.

This is a contract position; employment will be through a vendor contracted with Zoox. The hourly rate is as posted, and benefits eligibility is determined by the vendor.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
fit_why: Web full-stack tools match; Jira, deployment, dashboards align well

Job Title: 

Data Engineering Intern - Summer 2027 
 
 Job Description: 

 Data Engineering Intern - Summer 2027

Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission.

 The Role: 
Our site in Aurora, IL is seeking a Data Engineering Intern to join our team for the Summer 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 12-14 weeks in duration.
 
The Data Engineering Intern will support Entegris’ AI-ready data platform strategy by working on real-world initiatives spanning cloud data engineering, data products, metadata management, automation, and Generative AI enablement. The intern will help build and optimize data pipelines, improve data quality and governance, enrich metadata and business context, and contribute to AI-focused initiatives such as document ingestion, knowledge management, and the development of AI-powered data engineering agents that automate tasks including metadata discovery, data quality monitoring, lineage documentation, pipeline observability, and engineering productivity workflows. Key deliverables include AI-ready datasets, data quality scorecards, metadata enrichment, intelligent automation solutions, engineering agents, monitoring dashboards, and reusable data engineering assets. The role will provide immediate value to Entegris by accelerating data platform initiatives, increasing engineering efficiency through AI-driven automation, improving data readiness for analytics and AI, and supporting the company’s vision of becoming an AI-native enterprise. In turn, the intern will gain hands-on experience with modern data engineering on Google Cloud, SQL, Python, BigQuery, DataOps, metadata management, AI agent development, Generative AI, and enterprise-scale data product development while collaborating with business and technology teams on strategic initiatives.

 What You’ll Do: 

• Assist with building, testing, and optimizing data pipelines to ingest, transform, and deliver data from enterprise source systems into analytics and AI platforms. 
• Analyze, profile, and validate data to identify data quality issues, support business requirements, and improve the accuracy and reliability of enterprise datasets. 
• Develop SQL and Python-based solutions to automate data processing, validation, reporting, and other engineering workflows. 
• Support the development and testing of AI-powered data engineering agents that automate activities such as metadata discovery, documentation generation, data quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and engineering productivity tasks. 
• Prepare and validate AI-ready datasets and data products for analytics, reporting, machine learning, and Generative AI initiatives. 
• Create and maintain technical documentation, metadata, and data lineage artifacts to improve data discoverability, governance, and knowledge sharing. 
• Build dashboards and monitoring solutions that provide visibility into pipeline performance, data quality metrics, and platform operational health. 
• Collaborate with data engineers, architects, analysts, and business stakeholders using Agile development practices to support project delivery. 
• Research and evaluate emerging technologies in data engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, and cloud data platforms, and provide recommendations to the team. 
• Present internship accomplishments, findings, and recommendations to Data & AI Engineering leadership at the conclusion of the internship.

 What We Seek: 

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Software Engineering.Coursework or academic project experience in data structures, databases, software development, data analytics, machine learning, artificial intelligence, or cloud computing. 
• Foundational knowledge of SQL and experience querying relational databases.Basic programming experience in Python, Java, or a similar programming language. 
• Familiarity with data engineering, data analytics, or data science concepts through coursework, academic projects, internships, or extracurricular activities. 
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. 
• Effective verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to document technical concepts and present findings. 
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team-oriented environment. 
• Interest in modern data platforms, cloud technologies, automation, Generative AI, and AI-powered engineering solutions.Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, or Amazon Web Services (AWS).Exposure to data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. 
• Familiarity with Git, GitHub, or other source control systems. 
• Exposure to AI technologies such as large language models (LLMs), AI agents, prompt engineering, or Generative AI applications.

Lightmatter is leading the revolution in AI data center infrastructure, enabling the next giant leaps in human progress. The company invented the world’s first 3D-stacked photonics engine, Passage™, capable of connecting thousands to millions of processors at the speed of light in extreme-scale data centers for the most advanced AI and HPC workloads.

 Lightmatter raised $400 million in its Series D round, reaching a valuation of $4.4 billion. We will continue to accelerate the development of data center photonics and grow every department at Lightmatter!

 If you're passionate about tackling complex challenges, making an impact, and being an expert in your craft, join our team of brilliant scientists, engineers, and accomplished industry leaders.

 Lightmatter is (re)inventing the future of computing with light!

 About this job  

 Are you ready to do meaningful internship work on technology that is changing how AI systems are built? This team is Lightmatter's Central Data Platform, the Snowflake foundation that engineering, product, and analytics teams across the company build on. This summer you will help bring AI into that platform: Cortex Agents that answer questions over trusted data, semantic views that give those agents a shared definition of business metrics, and AI features built into applications already running in Snowflake. The components you build will be documented and reused by engineering teams across Lightmatter.

 Responsibilities: 

• Build and evaluate Cortex Agents that combine Cortex Analyst (structured data) and Cortex Search (documents) to answer engineering and analytics questions in natural language. 

• Design semantic views over core data products, defining metrics, dimensions, and relationships so agents and BI tools return consistent answers. 

• Integrate AI into applications already deployed in Snowflake, such as Streamlit apps, using Cortex AI SQL functions and agents exposed through Snowflake's managed MCP server. 

• Set up the AI gateway, observability, and orchestration layer: governed model access, evaluations and tracing, cost and usage monitoring, and scheduled workflows. 

• Package the work as reusable, documented platform components (templates, Cortex Code skills, runbooks) and demo them to engineering teams at the end of the internship. 
 
 Requirements:  

• Currently enrolled in a Master's program in Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field 

• Interest in data engineering, data platforms, and applied AI 

• Demonstrated interest in building and improving AI-based tools, shown through personal projects, coursework, research, or open-source contributions 
 
 Preferred Qualifications 

• Coursework, projects, or internship experience with SQL, Python and cloud data warehouses (Snowflake preferred). 
 Our internship hourly rates are a standard pay determined based on the position and your location, year in school, degree, and experience.

 Hourly Rate in USD
 $50 — $55 USD 

 Benefits

• Comprehensive Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision) 

• Retirement Savings Matching Program 

• Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D) 

• Generous Time Off (Vacation, Sick & Public Holidays) 

• Paid Family Leave 

• Short Term & Long Term Disability 

• Training & Development 

• Commuter Benefits 

• Flexible, hybrid workplace model 

• Equity grants (applicable to full-time employees) 
 
 Benefits eligibility may vary depending on your employment status and location. Lightmatter recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

 Export Control 

 Candidates should have capacity to comply with the federally mandated requirements of U.S. export control laws.
